author: reek
body: The content is the real work and it hashes to the digest it was quoted by. It is offered with no signature at all.

author: reek
body: A hash says what a definition is. Only a signature says who stands behind it. An unsigned work is not anonymous code we might take a chance on -- it is code with nobody to hold responsible for it, and no score to weigh, because there is no one to score.
